events.title: Robotics Workshop: Presented by Power Beans Foundation

cases.refreshed: In this full-day workshop with the Power Beans Foundation, participants will learn the principles of robot design and engineering, along with teamwork and collaboration skills. Teams will build VEX V5RC robots, program them with VEXcode, and showcase them in a friendly competition near the end. Lunch is from noon to 12:30 p.m. Please bring your own lunch. Participants need a signed waiver before taking part. Copies will be emailed and available on arrival. Participants must be at least 10 years old. Registration is required. Registered participants will receive a detailed agenda. Registration opens November 4, 2026, at 9 a.m.

events.title: Volunteer Craft Table at Los Gatos Magical Memories

cases.refreshed: NUMU is seeking volunteers for its community table at the Magical Memories event, helping with set-up, breakdown, and craft management. Shifts run 12:30-2 PM, 2-4 PM, and 4-5:30 PM.
cases.reviewed: New Museum Los Gatos is seeking volunteers to set up, run, and take down its community craft table at Magical Memories. Shifts run 12:30–2 PM, 2–4 PM, and 4–5:30 PM.
